name: Zulrah
description: Solo snake boss in its shrine off Zul-Andra, reached by fairy ring BJS or a Zul-andra teleport scroll, then the sacrificial boat at the dock. Zulrah keeps diving and coming back up in a new spot and a new form: green attacks with Ranged and is weak to Magic, red whips its tail at the tile it stares at, so step away, and blue mixes Magic and Ranged and is weak to Ranged. Its phases follow one of four fixed rotations, so learn them, pray against each form and try to finish the kill inside the first rotation. The loot appears under you, along with a teleport back to Zul-Andra, and every kill gives Zulrah's scales, with rare tanzanite and magic fangs, the serpentine visage and the mutagens. Recommended 80+ Ranged or 75+ Magic, 70+ Defence, 80+ Hitpoints and 45+ Prayer.

name: Vorkath
description: Solo undead dragon boss on Ungael, reached by talking to Torfinn on the Rellekka docks after Dragon Slayer II. Vorkath uses six normal attacks, then a special, then six more and the other special: during the acid special, keep walking back and forth on a clean line of tiles to dodge the rapid fireballs, and during the ice special you are frozen and must kill the zombified spawn, usually with Crumble Undead, before Vorkath can be hurt again. Keep up antifire protection the whole fight and step two tiles away from the big fireball that lands where you stand. Loot drops on a tile beside the body, and every kill gives superior dragon bones and blue dragonhide, with rare draconic and skeletal visages and a guaranteed Vorkath's head on the 50th kill. Recommended 85+ Ranged (or 80+ Attack and 85+ Strength for melee), 75+ Defence and 70+ Prayer.

name: Abyssal Sire
description: Slayer boss in the Abyssal Nexus, reached by fairy ring DIP, and only fought on an abyssal demon task with 85 Slayer and access to the Abyss. First stun the Sire with 75 damage or a Shadow spell, then kill its four respiratory systems while it is stunned. Next fight it in melee range, moving off the miasma pools, until it walks south and latches onto the floor with tentacles and spawns around it. At the end it teleports you next to it and explodes, so run away at once, then come back and finish it. It is worth doing for the unsired, which you offer at the Font of Consumption for an abyssal whip, dagger, bludgeon piece or the pet. Recommended 90+ in the combat stats and 70+ Prayer.

name: Kraken
description: Slayer boss in its own room in Kraken Cove, reached by fairy ring AKQ and running west, and only fought on a cave kraken task with 87 Slayer (the task itself needs 50 Magic). Wake the four small whirlpools to bring up the tentacles, then the big one to bring up the Kraken, or use a fishing explosive on the big whirlpool. Kill it with Magic, since melee cannot reach it and Ranged does a seventh of the damage, and expect steady chip damage, because its typeless attacks cannot be prayed against. Loot lands on the ground, and a private instance costs 25,000 coins if the public room is crowded. It is worth doing for the kraken tentacle and the trident of the seas. Recommended 75+ Magic, 70+ Defence and 75+ Hitpoints.

description: Slayer boss at the bottom of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm, reached by fairy ring CIR or Rada's blessing, and only fought on a hydra task with 95 Slayer. description: Six brothers buried in mounds east of Mort'ton in Morytania, reached by Barrows Teleport, a Barrows teleport tablet or a Mort'ton teleport. A harpoon, rope, bucket and hammer can all be picked up there. Catch and cook harpoonfish and load them into the cannons to drain its energy, then fish the spirit pool to drain its essence. Tie yourself to a mast or totem with a rope before waves, and put out fires with buckets of water, since its attacks do no damage but can cost you fish and tools, and the game is lost if the storm meter fills. Points become permits to search the reward pool, which gives the fish barrel, tackle box, tome of water and dragon harpoon.

name: Guardians of the Rift
description: Runecraft minigame in the Temple of the Eye, reached through the portal in the Wizards' Tower basement or by Minigame Teleport, with a pickaxe and a chisel. Mine guardian fragments, turn them into guardian essence, and take it through the active elemental and catalytic portals to craft runes and guardian stones. Bring the stones back to power up the Great Guardian, while players also build barriers and rift guardians to hold off the abyssal creatures. When the guardian is fully charged the rift closes, and you get Runecraft experience and searches of the Rewards Guardian for runes and abyssal pearls, which buy the raiments of the eye outfit, the abyssal needle and the abyssal protector pet. Needs the Temple of the Eye quest and 27 Runecraft.

name: Fight Caves
description: Solo minigame inside the Karamja volcano at Mor Ul Rek, reached by fairy ring BLP or the TzHaar Fight Pit Minigame Teleport. You fight 63 waves of TzHaar creatures, best killed from range and in order of threat, and you can log out between waves to save your progress. Wave 63 is TzTok-Jad: watch his animation and switch to Protect from Magic when he rears up or Protect from Missiles when he slams the ground, and kill his healers when they appear below half health. Beating him gives the fire cape and Tokkul. There is no hard requirement, but the usual ranged way suggests 75 Ranged and Hitpoints, 70 Defence and 60 Prayer.

name: Start tree runs
description:

* Check the grown tree's health for the xp
* Pay the gardener to clear it
* Plant the next sapling
* Pay the gardener to protect it

* Lumbridge, Varrock, Falador and Taverley
* Gnome Stronghold
* Farming Guild (65 Farming)

name: Start birdhouse runs
description:
Four bird house spots on Fossil Island fill with birds about 50 minutes after you set them.
Setting one:
* Build a bird house from logs and a clockwork, with a hammer and chisel
* Place it on the spot
* Fill it with 10 seeds. Any hop, herb, flower, bush or allotment seed gives the same loot
Emptying a full house gives the clockwork back, so four clockworks last forever.
Route:
* Digsite pendant to Fossil Island
* Magic mushtree to Verdant Valley, the north house then the south one
* Mushtree to Mushroom Meadow for the third
* Run south to the Tar Swamp for the fourth
Which bird house (Hunter, then Crafting):
* Regular 5 and 5
* Oak 14 and 15
* Willow 24 and 25
* Teak 34 and 35
* Maple 44 and 45
* Mahogany 49 and 50
* Yew 59 and 60
* Magic 74 and 75
* Redwood 89 and 90

name: Buy a Graceful outfit
description: The Graceful outfit is bought from Grace in the Rogues' Den under the Toad and Chicken in Burthorpe, using marks of grace. Marks appear on Agility courses, mostly the rooftop courses, and you pick them up as you run laps. The full set costs 260 marks, the legs 60, top 55, cape and boots 40 each, hood 35 and gloves 30. Canifis, from 40 Agility, is the popular place to farm them. Wearing the whole set cuts your weight and makes run energy come back 30% faster.

name: Rooftop courses, for marks of grace
description: Marks of grace appear on rooftop courses, at most one every 3 minutes. From level 40, Canifis gives the most, about 12 to 18 an hour, until Ardougne at 90. A course 20 or more levels below you drops 80% fewer marks, Canifis excepted. Marks vanish after 10 minutes on the ground. A full Graceful outfit is 260 marks.
